name: Madrid Transit Pack
description: Standardized Madrid train types by network: Metro narrow-profile (S/3000), Metro wide-profile (S/8000-9000), Metro Ligero (Citadis 302) and Cercanías (S/452 X'Trapolis). Real-world specs (gradients, speeds, radii, platform lengths) from official technical norms. One type per network instead of per-model, so branches between lines of the same network are fully compatible.
